verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own diarization docs say developers enable speaker diarization through a request parameter (diarize_model), which also selects the model version, so the core of the story is first-party documented. The evidence is a single thin mention and does not show the speaker labels in the transcript output. Multichannel per-channel transcripts are a separate feature and are not credited here. missing for 10: documentation of per-word or per-utterance speaker labels in the response, detail on diarization accuracy or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: Use the diarize_model parameter to enable diarization and select the model version in a single parameter
